note: Everything here is a slot for the DM to fill or a prompt written for this box. It holds no text from the adventure booklet. Names and quest details are from memory: check them against your booklet, and trust the booklet.

rules_edition.why: The kit was written for the 2014 rules. Pick one before session one and do not mix.

sidekicks.why: For one or two players. Record who the party hired.

home_base.why: Where the party sleeps and keeps things in Phandalin.

dragon_table.why: Copy the 20 results of the booklet's dragon location table here once, yourself, from your own booklet: replace each null with the words for that roll, in quotes. The DM desk's Tables tile (More, then Tables) then rolls a d20, shows you where it is and logs it. Until you do, that screen says the table has not been copied in.

dragon_roll_when.why: Write down when the booklet tells you to roll, so you do it the same way every time.

dragon_condition.why: Hit points and anything else that carries over if the party hurts the dragon and it gets away.

levelling.method: Quests finished, not experience points. The booklet's table rules; this is the pattern to check against it.

board_rules.posted: when two tier 1 quests are finished
when two tier 2 quests are finished

quests.name: Dwarven Excavation
quests.watch_for: Slow, tough oozes inside. More trouble arrives as the party leaves.
quests.box_setup: Load both fights. Add the two prospectors to People.

quests.name: Gnomengarde
quests.watch_for: Mostly a mystery, not a fight. Strange magic effects in one area.
quests.box_setup: Have Dice ready for the magic effects. Add both kings to People.

quests.name: Umbrage Hill
quests.watch_for: The monster is far too strong for level 1 in a straight fight. It can be talked to or bought off.
quests.box_setup: Load the fight, but plan the conversation first.

quests.name: Butterskull Ranch
quests.watch_for: Many weak enemies spread over a site. A frontal attack draws them all.
quests.box_setup: Load the enemies as one group entry plus a leader.

quests.name: Loggers' Camp
quests.watch_for: Burrowing monsters appear among the party. Travel is by river.
quests.box_setup: Log travel days. Load the ambush.

quests.name: Mountain's Toe Gold Mine
quests.watch_for: The occupants shrug off ordinary weapons. A party with no magic or silver cannot win by force. Talking works.
quests.box_setup: Check what magic weapons and spells the party has before this session.

quests.name: Axeholm
quests.watch_for: The longest site. One undead here can drop several characters at once with a single ability.
quests.box_setup: Plan two sessions. Load fights room by room. Review death saves.

quests.name: Dragon Barrow
quests.watch_for: Traps more than monsters. The prize matters for the finale.
quests.box_setup: Add the prize to Treasure when found.

quests.name: Woodland Manse
quests.watch_for: Cultists who change shape, plus plant creatures. Fire matters.

quests.name: Shrine of Savras
quests.watch_for: Big bruisers. Fine for level 3 and up.

quests.name: Tower of Storms
quests.watch_for: Coastal site. Tide and weather matter.

quests.name: Circle of Thunder
quests.watch_for: A summoning the party can interrupt. The summoned creature is a boss fight.

quests.name: Falcon's Hunting Lodge
quests.watch_for: No fight expected. A good place to rest and get a lead.

quests.name: Icespire Hold
quests.watch_for: The dragon's lair. Other people want the dragon too.
quests.box_setup: Load the dragon with its current condition from Fixed results.

tables_why: Other roll tables, copied in by you from your own books. Each one: a name, the die, and a row for each result, like "Name": {"die": 20, "rows": [{"lo": 1, "hi": 2, "text": "your words"}]}. The dragon's location table has its own slot above, under fixed_results, dragon_table.

people.name: Harbin Wester
people.role: Townmaster. Posts the jobs and pays for them.

people.name: Linene Graywind
people.role: Runs the Lionshield Coster trading post.

people.name: Falcon the Hunter
people.role: Veteran hunter. His lodge makes a safe base.

session_outline.title: Session zero
prep: Choose the rules edition
Make characters together
Hire sidekicks if there are one or two players
Agree how character death is handled

session_outline.title: Arrival and the job board
prep: Read the booklet's running-the-adventure and Phandalin sections
Read all three tier 1 quests
Load the fight for whichever quest they are likeliest to pick
Plan a first dragon sighting that is a fly-over, not a fight

session_outline.title: Second starting quest
prep: Read the quest they did not pick
Level the party to 2 before, 3 after
Roll for the dragon

session_outline.title: Third starting quest, or town
prep: Post the three tier 2 quests
Let the party spend gold and meet townsfolk
Decide the home base

session_outline.title: Tier 2, first quest
prep: Read all three tier 2 quests
Check the party's magic weapons before Mountain's Toe

session_outline.title: Tier 2, second quest
prep: Level to 4 after
Post the three tier 3 quests

session_outline.title: Tier 2, third quest or a side site
prep: Use a side site if the party is wandering

session_outline.title: Tier 3, first quest
prep: Read all three tier 3 quests
If it is Axeholm, plan two sessions

session_outline.title: Tier 3, continued
prep: Level to 5 when four later quests are done

session_outline.title: Tier 3, second quest
prep: Make sure the party has heard where the dragon lairs

session_outline.title: Tier 3, third quest
prep: Level to 6 when six later quests are done

session_outline.title: Loose ends
prep: Close open quests
Let the party prepare: potions, allies, the Dragon Barrow prize

session_outline.title: Icespire Hold
prep: Read the lair twice
Load every fight in advance
Set the dragon's condition from Fixed results

prep_checklist: Read the recap aloud and fix it
Open the booklet to tonight's pages
Skim the people likely to appear
Lay out the map, quest cards and handouts
Pick one thing to cut if the night runs long
